outtaskno, tasksource, taskcomment, storeroomid, collecter, outstate, collectkind, outdate, outdesc, forcesite, forcebatch, dataversion, data1, data2, data3, data4, data5, data6, data7, data8, batchflag, productline, workstation, beatflag,
#{outtaskno}, #{tasksource}, #{taskcomment}, #{storeroomid}, #{collecter}, #{outstate}, #{collectkind}, #{outdate}, #{outdesc}, #{forcesite}, #{forcebatch}, #{dataversion}, #{data1}, #{data2}, #{data3}, #{data4}, #{data5}, #{data6}, #{data7}, #{data8}, #{batchflag}, #{productline}, #{workstation}, #{beatflag},
mapper.delete:
delete from outtask where outtaskid in

mapper.select:
select ab.* from( select distinct taskcomment, storeroomno, orderno, po_number, forcesite, forcebatch, outtaskno, outdesc, workstation, outtaskid, batchflag, beatflag, delivery_data, delivery_time, wip_supplement_flag, schedule_group_name, outdate
from ( select b.taskcomment, nvl(c.storeroomno,' ') as storeroomno, nvl(op.orderno,' ') as orderno, nvl(op.po_number,' ') as po_number, b.forcesite, b.forcebatch, b.outtaskno, d.storesiteno, f.matcode, f.matname, a.palletno, nvl(b.outdesc,' ') as outdesc, b.outtaskid, e.operation, e.userid, nvl(a.outstate,0) as outstate, nvl(b.collecter,0) as collecter, nvl(a.collecter,0) as i_collecter, nvl(b.collecter,0) as t_collecter, b.outdate, c.roomtag, a.hintqty, a.collectedqty, a.outtaskitemid, nvl(op.wip_supplement_flag,'N') as wip_supplement_flag, nvl(g.schedule_group_name,'') as schedule_group_name, nvl(g.workstation,'N') as workstation, nvl(op.transfertype,'0') as transfertype, nvl(b.batchflag,0) as batchflag, g.delivery_data, g.delivery_time, b.beatflag from outtaskitem a, outtask b, storeroom c, storesite d, (select distinct r.USER_ID as userid,m.STOREROOMID as operation from sys_user_role r,sys_role_room m where r.ROLE_ID=m.ROLE_ID) e, pm_material f, outbill g, outproof op where a.outtaskid = b.outtaskid and a.outbillid = g.outbillid and a.hintsite = d.storesiteid and a.materialid = f.pm_materialid and b.storeroomid = c.storeroomid and c.storeroomid = e.operation and g.outproofid = op.outproofid and b.tasksource = op.outproofid and nvl(a.hintfinish,0) = 0 and nvl(g.hintfinish,0) = 0 and nvl(a.hintqty,0) - nvl(a.collectedqty,0) > 0
and nvl(b.beatflag,'N')=#{beatflag} and NVL(b.batchflag,0) = #{batchflag} and nvl(a.collecter,0) = #{i_collecter} and nvl(a.outstate,0) = #{outstate} and e.userid = #{userId} and b.taskcomment like concat(concat('%',#{taskcomment}),'%') and nvl(g.workstation,'N')= #{workstation} and b.outtaskno = #{outtaskno} and c.roomtag = #{roomTag} and nvl(op.transfertype,'0') = #{transferType} )aa )ab where 1=1
and( ab.taskcomment like concat(concat('%',#{searchKey}),'%') or ab.orderno like concat(concat('%',#{searchKey}),'%') or ab.outtaskno like concat(concat('%',#{searchKey}),'%') or ab.po_number like concat(concat('%',#{searchKey}),'%') )
order by ab.outdate desc,ab.taskcomment desc, ab.orderno desc,ab.outtaskno desc order by ab.${sortColumn} ${sortType}

select ab.* from( select distinct taskcomment, storeroomno, orderno, po_number, forcesite, forcebatch, outtaskno, outdesc, workstation, outtaskid, batchflag, beatflag, delivery_data, delivery_time, wip_supplement_flag, schedule_group_name, outdate
from ( select b.taskcomment, nvl(c.storeroomno,' ') as storeroomno, nvl(op.orderno,' ') as orderno, nvl(op.po_number,' ') as po_number, b.forcesite, b.forcebatch, b.outtaskno, d.storesiteno, f.matcode, f.matname, a.palletno, nvl(b.outdesc,' ') as outdesc, b.outtaskid, e.operation, e.userid, nvl(a.outstate,0) as outstate, nvl(b.collecter,0) as collecter, nvl(a.collecter,0) as i_collecter, nvl(b.collecter,0) as t_collecter, b.outdate, c.roomtag, a.hintqty, a.collectedqty, a.outtaskitemid, nvl(op.wip_supplement_flag,'N') as wip_supplement_flag, nvl(g.schedule_group_name,'') as schedule_group_name, nvl(g.workstation,'N') as workstation, nvl(op.transfertype,'0') as transfertype, nvl(b.batchflag,0) as batchflag, g.delivery_data, g.delivery_time, b.beatflag from outtaskitem a, outtask b, storeroom c, storesite d, (select distinct r.USER_ID as userid,m.STOREROOMID as operation from sys_user_role r,sys_role_room m where r.ROLE_ID=m.ROLE_ID) e, pm_material f, outbill g, outproof op where a.outtaskid = b.outtaskid and a.outbillid = g.outbillid and a.hintsite = d.storesiteid and a.materialid = f.pm_materialid and b.storeroomid = c.storeroomid and c.storeroomid = e.operation and g.outproofid = op.outproofid and b.tasksource = op.outproofid
and nvl(a.hintfinish,0) = 0 and nvl(g.hintfinish,0) = 0
and nvl(a.outstate,0) != 0
and nvl(b.beatflag,'N')=#{beatflag} and NVL(b.batchflag,0) = #{batchflag} and nvl(a.collecter,0) = #{i_collecter} and nvl(a.outstate,0) = #{outstate} and e.userid = #{userId} and b.taskcomment like concat(concat('%',#{taskcomment}),'%') and nvl(g.workstation,'N')= #{workstation} and b.outtaskno = #{outtaskno} and c.roomtag = #{roomTag} and nvl(op.transfertype,'0') = #{transferType} )aa )ab where 1=1
and( ab.taskcomment like concat(concat('%',#{searchKey}),'%') or ab.orderno like concat(concat('%',#{searchKey}),'%') or ab.outtaskno like concat(concat('%',#{searchKey}),'%') or ab.po_number like concat(concat('%',#{searchKey}),'%') )
order by ab.outdate desc,ab.taskcomment desc, ab.orderno desc,ab.outtaskno desc order by ab.${sortColumn} ${sortType}
